children: Shapoorji Pallonji Group, the second-largest shareholder in Tata Sons, on Friday backed a potential listing of the holding company of India's sprawling Tata conglomerate, signalling support for a move that could reshape the ownership of one of the country's best-known business groups.
"Look forward to working closely and constructively with Tata Sons towards listing," the group said in a statement.
